title: AMP三步管风险
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/24_BIORISK MANAGEMENT THE 'AMP' MODEL CC-BY.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/24_BIORISK MANAGEMENT THE 'AMP' MODEL CC-BY/src.py

points.K12: 危害是物，风险来自操作

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个相连的彩色圆圈前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three connected coloured circles.
shots.narration: 这一课，学用AMP三步管风险。

shots.scene: 三个圆圈循环转动，中间一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three circles rotate in a loop around a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，一圈一圈转。

shots.scene: 快递员推来一箱血样，阿杰签收
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs for a box of blood sample tubes on a cart.
shots.narration: 阿杰的实验室收到一百份血样。

shots.scene: 阿杰卷起袖子想马上开盖做检测，小研摆手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rolls up his sleeves to open the tubes; the female graduate student waves to stop him.
shots.narration: 他想马上开做，小研拦住了他。

shots.scene: 小研拿出空白评估表和三个圆圈图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a blank assessment form with a three-circle icon.
shots.narration: 小研说：先用AMP把风险理一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张写着AMP的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with three circle icons.
shots.narration: AMP，是管理生物风险的基本模型。

shots.scene: 七个图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Seven icons in a column. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课有七个目标：

shots.scene: 两个图标：推荐措施、评审绩效
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a recommendation note and a performance review clipboard. No people.
shots.narration: 还有提出措施，评审效果。

shots.scene: 五个对勾方框
shots.prompt_en: Five check boxes, each ticked in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 学完要能做到五件事：

shots.scene: 一份案例卷宗和一张反馈卡
shots.prompt_en: A case-study folder and a feedback card. No people.
shots.narration: 考核看你能不能完成案例分析。

shots.scene: 八个小图标像目录一样排开
shots.prompt_en: Eight small icons laid out like a table of contents. No people.
shots.narration: 课程分八部分：模型、危害与风险、

shots.scene: 目录后半部分的图标依次点亮
shots.prompt_en: The second half of the icons light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 结构化分析、评估、减缓、绩效、案例。

shots.scene: 小研一边看规程一边操作，规程和动作对齐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows a blank SOP sheet step by step at her bench.
shots.narration: 通用准则：做你所写，

shots.scene: 小研把做过的步骤记进记录本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes the completed steps into a record book.
shots.narration: 写你所做。规程和记录要一致。

shots.scene: 计划、执行、检查、行动四个方块循环
shots.prompt_en: Four blocks in a loop: plan, do, check, act. No people.
shots.narration: 这就对应计划、执行、检查、行动。

shots.scene: 评估、减缓、绩效三个圆圈带箭头循环
shots.prompt_en: Three circles with arrows forming a loop. No people.
shots.narration: AMP就是：评估、减缓、绩效。

shots.scene: 循环箭头转了一圈又一圈
shots.prompt_en: The loop arrows keep cycling round. No people.
shots.narration: 做完一圈，再来一圈，不断改进。

shots.scene: 第一个箭头A旁出现问号
shots.prompt_en: A first arrow tab with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 评估问：有什么风险？

shots.scene: 第二个箭头M旁出现下降箭头
shots.prompt_en: A second arrow tab with a downward arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 减缓问：怎样把风险降下来？

shots.scene: 第三个箭头P旁出现放大镜和对勾
shots.prompt_en: A third arrow tab with a magnifying glass and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 绩效问：怎么确认真的降下来了？

shots.scene: 一把刀、一个电插头、一个微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a knife, a power plug, and a microbe. No people.
shots.narration: 危害，是任何可能造成伤害的东西。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志放大
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard warning sign zooms in. No people.
shots.narration: 生物因子，就可能是潜在危害。

shots.scene: 冻存罐里一支封好的管子，风险条很短
shots.prompt_en: A sealed tube in a cryo-storage tank with a very short risk bar. No people.
shots.narration: 样本冻在罐里，风险很低；

shots.scene: 管子到提取台，风险条变长
shots.prompt_en: The tube moves to an extraction bench; the risk bar grows. No people.
shots.narration: 拿出来提取核酸，风险升高；

shots.scene: 培养瓶里微生物增多，风险条最长
shots.prompt_en: A culture flask with multiplying microbe icons; the risk bar is longest. No people.
shots.narration: 培养活的病原，风险最高。

shots.section_title: 危害是物，风险来自操作
shots.scene: 架子上一个关着的样本盒，标危害
shots.prompt_en: A closed sample box on a shelf, tagged with a hazard icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物因子本身是危害，
overlay: 危害是物，风险来自操作

shots.section_title: 危害是物，风险来自操作
shots.scene: 一双手打开样本盒，风险标志亮起
shots.prompt_en: Hands open the sample box and a risk warning lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 动手操作它，才带来风险。

shots.scene: 一枚骰子，旁边四格由浅到深
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon beside four boxes shaded light to dark. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性问：发生的概率多大？

shots.scene: 一个冲击波图标，旁边四格由浅到深
shots.prompt_en: An impact-burst icon beside four boxes shaded light to dark. No people.
shots.narration: 后果问：万一发生，会怎样？

shots.scene: 四乘四方格，横轴可能性，纵轴后果
shots.prompt_en: A four-by-four grid with likelihood on one axis and consequence on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 两者一交叉，就是风险矩阵。

shots.scene: 格子里依次亮起几组字母组合
shots.prompt_en: Several cells of the grid light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 得到低低、低中、中中、中高等组合。

shots.scene: 五层金字塔从上到下点亮
shots.prompt_en: A five-band pyramid lighting up from top to bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 降风险按控制层级，从上往下选：

shots.scene: 欣欣从金字塔顶指到底
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points from the top of the pyramid down to the bottom.
shots.narration: 从消除到个人防护，一共五层。

shots.scene: 一只张开的手掌，五指连着五个彩色圆
shots.prompt_en: An open hand with five fingers linked to five coloured circles. No people.
shots.narration: 用五根手指来记：

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出五指一根根数
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up one paw and counts five fingers one by one.
shots.narration: 消除、替代、工程、管理、防护。

shots.scene: 红色盾牌护着一个人形
shots.prompt_en: A red shield protecting a person outline. No people.
shots.narration: 一级封闭，保护工作的人；

shots.scene: 绿色盾牌护着一棵树和一座城镇
shots.prompt_en: A green shield protecting a tree and a small town. No people.
shots.narration: 二级封闭，保护外面的环境。

shots.scene: 桌上一叠便利贴，两个空盒子
shots.prompt_en: A pad of sticky notes and two empty boxes on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 来做个练习：准备便利贴和两个盒子。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰分成两组，在便利贴上写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student each write on sticky notes at separate tables.
shots.narration: 一组写护人的，一组写护环境的。

shots.scene: 实验服、手套、口罩、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, gloves, a mask, and goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 一级封闭：实验服、手套、口罩、眼罩，

shots.scene: 送风呼吸器和生物安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a powered air-purifying respirator and a biosafety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 送风呼吸器、生物安全柜，

shots.scene: 穿脱防护的空白规程卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank card showing donning and doffing step icons. No people.
shots.narration: 还有穿脱防护的规程。

shots.scene: 便利贴贴进标一级的盒子
shots.prompt_en: Sticky notes go into the box labelled with a red shield. No people.
shots.narration: 这些贴进一级的盒子。

shots.scene: 高效过滤器、废水处理罐、通风机组图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a high-efficiency filter, a wastewater treatment tank, and an air-handling unit. No people.
shots.narration: 二级封闭：高效过滤、废水去污、通风，

shots.scene: 扳手日历、运输箱、废物袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a maintenance wrench with a calendar, a transport box, and a waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 定期维护，运输和废物处置的规程。

shots.scene: 便利贴贴进标二级的盒子
shots.prompt_en: Sticky notes go into the box labelled with a green shield. No people.
shots.narration: 这些贴进二级的盒子。

shots.scene: 两组便利贴拼成一间实验室的轮廓
shots.prompt_en: The two sets of sticky notes arrange into the outline of a laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 两层拼在一起，

shots.scene: 轮廓变成一间完整的实验室示意图
shots.prompt_en: The outline becomes a complete laboratory diagram with two layers of shields. No people.
shots.narration: 就是一间生物安全实验室的雏形。

shots.scene: 风险条被几层控制压短，还剩一小截
shots.prompt_en: A risk bar pressed shorter by several control layers, with a small piece left. No people.
shots.narration: 控制加完，总还剩一点残余风险。

shots.scene: 老周和组员围桌讨论，举手表决
shots.prompt_en: The older man and team members around a table raise hands to agree.
shots.narration: 要问团队：愿意带着它工作吗？

shots.scene: 放大镜对着几层控制
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass held over several control layers. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么确认控制真的有效？

shots.scene: 第二张评估表叠在第一张上
shots.prompt_en: A second assessment form placed on top of the first. No people.
shots.narration: 减缓之后，再做一次风险评估。

shots.scene: 一箱血样管，旁边一个大写X图标
shots.prompt_en: A box of blood sample tubes beside a large letter X icon. No people.
shots.narration: 案例：一批疑似感染X的患者血样。

shots.scene: 显微镜下没看到，抗体检测出阳性
shots.prompt_en: A microscope with an empty view, and an antibody test showing positive. No people.
shots.narration: 镜检没查到，但抗体测到了，未确证。

shots.scene: 一只蜱的图标，人与人之间打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tick icon with an arrow to a person, and a crossed-out arrow between two people. No people.
shots.narration: 已知靠蜱叮咬传，未见人传人。

shots.scene: 流程：分离血清，再做酶联免疫检测
shots.prompt_en: A flow: serum separated from blood, then into a plate assay. No people.
shots.narration: 要做的是分离血清，再做免疫检测。

shots.scene: 一条长流程被剪成一个个小方块
shots.prompt_en: A long process line cut into individual small blocks. No people.
shots.narration: 结构化评估：把流程拆成单步，

shots.scene: 每个小方块旁配一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Each block gets its own question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 一步一步评估。

shots.scene: 八个方块依次点亮前四个
shots.prompt_en: Eight blocks in a row; the first four light up. No people.
shots.narration: 本案例拆成八步：

shots.scene: 后四个方块依次点亮
shots.prompt_en: The last four blocks light up. No people.
shots.narration: 后面四步也不能漏。

shots.scene: 接收存放这一步，在矩阵左下格打点
shots.prompt_en: For the receiving step, a dot lands in the bottom-left cell of the grid. No people.
shots.narration: 比如接收存放，可能性低，后果低。

shots.scene: 八行表格逐行填满
shots.prompt_en: An eight-row table filling in row by row. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步都填进去，汇成累计矩阵。

shots.scene: 五个问号卡片排开
shots.prompt_en: Five question cards in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 然后每一步问五个问题：

shots.scene: 消除、替代两张卡翻开
shots.prompt_en: The elimination and substitution cards flip open. No people.
shots.narration: 能不能不做？能不能换个办法？

shots.scene: 工程、规程、防护三张卡翻开
shots.prompt_en: The engineering, procedure and protective equipment cards flip open. No people.
shots.narration: 能加设备吗？写规程吗？要什么防护？

shots.scene: 彩色汇总表，每行在几列打叉
shots.prompt_en: A colourful summary table with marks in several columns of each row. No people.
shots.narration: 把每步选的措施汇总成一张表。

shots.scene: 第一行在管理和防护两列打钩
shots.prompt_en: The first row is ticked under the administrative and PPE columns. No people.
shots.narration: 比如接收存放：靠规程和个人防护。

shots.scene: 四列表格：计划、执行、检查、行动
shots.prompt_en: A four-column table headed with plan, do, check and act icons. No people.
shots.narration: 最后用PDCA做绩效评估：

shots.scene: 计划列放规程，执行列打勾或问号
shots.prompt_en: A procedure sheet under plan; a check or question mark under do. No people.
shots.narration: 推荐了什么？真落实了吗？没有，为什么？

shots.scene: 检查列放记录本，行动列放审核章
shots.prompt_en: A log book under check; an audit stamp under act. No people.
shots.narration: 有没有记录？再审核、修改措施。

shots.scene: 欣欣把三个圆圈拼成一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot fits three circles together into a shield.
shots.narration: 这一课的核心：评估、减缓、绩效。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁：三个圆圈和五指手掌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside three circles and an open hand.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，五指记控制。

shots.scene: 红绿两个盾牌和一张拆成八步的流程
shots.prompt_en: A red shield, a green shield, and a process split into eight steps. No people.
shots.narration: 一级护人、二级护环境，流程拆开评。

shots.scene: 残余风险小截和PDCA四列表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a short leftover risk bar and a four-column plan-do-check-act table. No people.
shots.narration: 残余风险要认可，减缓后再评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手，身后盾牌发亮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with a glowing shield behind.
shots.narration: 做好生物安全，我们下次见！
